description: This file defines the DesktopManager class, a service responsible for managing desktop application behaviors such as event handling, synchronization of components, backups, and UI notifications within a web-based desktop environment. It extends ApplicationService and implements DesktopManagerInterface and DesktopClientRequiresWebMethods, integrating with various application and device interfaces.

classes.name: DesktopManager
classes.description: A service class managing desktop-specific application behaviors including event handling, component synchronization, backups, and notifications. It communicates with the device and web interfaces, and maintains observers for component updates.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up the update observers and calls the superclass deinit method.

methods.name: onAppEvent
methods.description: Handles application events, updating internal state and invoking device methods on specific events like data load or major data change.

methods.name: saveBackup
methods.description: Triggers a major data change event in the device to initiate a backup.

methods.name: getExtServerHost
methods.description: Returns the external server host URL from the device, asserting that it exists.

methods.name: convertComponentForTransmission
methods.description: Converts an SNComponent into a format suitable for transmission, in its raw state without encryption.

methods.name: syncComponentsInstallation
methods.description: Synchronizes multiple components by converting them for transmission and invoking device sync.

methods.name: registerUpdateObserver
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked on component updates, returning a function to unregister it.

methods.name: searchText
methods.description: Stores the search text and instructs the device to perform a search.

methods.name: redoSearch
methods.description: Repeats the last search if available.

methods.name: updateAvailable
methods.description: Notifies the web application that a new update is available.

methods.name: windowGainedFocus
methods.description: Notifies the web application that the window has gained focus.

methods.name: windowLostFocus
methods.description: Notifies the web application that the window has lost focus.

methods.name: onComponentInstallationComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of component installation by updating the item and notifying observers.

methods.name: requestBackupFile
methods.description: Generates and returns a JSON string of the backup data, encrypted or decrypted based on protection sources.

methods.name: didBeginBackup
methods.description: Notifies that a backup download has begun.

methods.name: didFinishBackup
methods.description: Notifies that a backup download has completed, indicating success or failure.
